title: Measurement 1 Redo: Concentration & Latency Budget over the Full Extended Day
baseline_original: tip of phase/6 (unapproved); master remains phase-5a-approved
supersedes: phase_6 (results/phase_6_rth_only/, digest status superseded_rth_only, no phase-6-approved tag ever created)

amendment.resumption_baseline: phase-7-approved (phase/6b fast-forwarded to it - D4, the t8 canonical view, and the approved 6c/7 docs must be present)
amendment.change: the primary opportunity-decay anchor is re-frozen from the D4-quarantined spine prev_close to the tick-derived tick_close_t_minus_1_rth; a strict-key duplicate-print counter is added to the full pass; chart 08 is dropped; the two t8 columns (flag_eth_dominant_t0, t0_eth_row_share) are flag/annotation, not quarantined.

universe.eligibility_rule: substr(trades_bitmap, 4, 1) = '1' (unchanged from Phase 6 - re-verified, not re-derived)
universe.primary_anchor_eligibility: has_t_minus_1_rth = the event has >=1 T-1 trade in segment {premarket, rth} (so tick_close_t_minus_1_rth is defined). Determined at T4 from event_minute_bars_v2 (not at T1 - it needs the bars). Flag-and-report: events without it are excluded from the primary decay population only, retained for concentration / min-window / segment / rth_legacy. The pre-D4 prev_close guard is removed (D4 quarantines prev_close).

session_calendar.pre_post_availability_check: installed pandas_market_calendars 5.4.0's XNYS calendar exposes market_times=['market_open','market_close'] only (verified via Calendar.market_times and schedule(market_times='all') at phase start) - no pre/post columns available. Escalation row 2 condition (schedule lacks pre/post) is therefore TRUE by measured fact; the fallback below is in effect for the whole phase, logged in the report, not an error.

extended_hours_fallback.early_close_rule: a session date is 'early close' if its XNYS market_close (converted to America/New_York) has a wall-clock time before 16:00:00 ET
extended_hours_fallback.rth_open_close_source: XNYS schedule market_open/market_close, converted from UTC to America/New_York (tz-aware) and then stripped to naive ET wall-clock for all downstream arithmetic

timezone.engine: DuckDB ICU extension (INSTALL icu; LOAD icu;), AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' applied to TO_TIMESTAMP(sip_timestamp/1e9)
timezone.note: Session-date and segment assignment use this ET-local wall-clock timestamp directly (CAST ... AS DATE, CAST ... AS TIME) - never the UTC-cast-to-date convention used through Phase 6, which misassigns EST-winter post-market prints after 19:00 ET to the next calendar day.

minute_index_origin: 04:00:00 ET on the session's own date (index 0), same origin for every offset's session

primary.anchor_note: A8.2/D4 tick anchor. Both inputs tick-only - no spine numeric column read (a62_d4_sweep.json: 0 measurement-path spine hits).
primary.tick_close_t_minus_1_rth_source: last_price of the max-minute_index bar at session_offset=-1 within segment IN ('premarket','rth') from event_minute_bars_v2 - the tick-derived last trade at/before the T-1 RTH close (a61 derivation, now the anchor). NULL -> has_t_minus_1_rth=FALSE.
primary.day_high_ext_source: MAX(bar.high) across all T=0 segments (premarket+rth+post) from event_minute_bars_v2 - our own trade data, tick-derived (never momentum_events.high)
primary.headline_a: minute since 04:00 ET at which pooled median realized(t) crosses 0.5
primary.headline_b: distribution of realized(t) evaluated at each event's own RTH-open minute (09:30 ET)
primary.headline_c: distribution of the ET clock time-of-day at which day_high_ext occurs

rth_legacy.definition: Phase 6's original: realized(t) = |log(last_price_t/open_price)| / |log(close_price/open_price)|, open_price = first RTH print, close_price = last RTH print
rth_legacy.purpose: direct comparability to Phase 6's 52/57-minute crossings - labeled rth_legacy everywhere it appears

chart_overlay.decile_source: momentum_pct deciles over the T1-eligible population (pd.qcut, 10 deciles, labels=False, duplicates='drop') - same convention as Phase 6

escalation_thresholds.relabel_integrity: file count and byte size of results/phase_6_rth_only/ must match pre-move results/phase_6/ exactly; event_minute_bars_v1 row count unchanged
escalation_thresholds.duplicate_print_note: 0.1% is the pre-D4 exact threshold, retained as a reference; the full-pass counter is APPROX (HLL), so row 7 gates on the 5% coarse flag (above HLL noise), not the exact 0.1%. Exact 0.0% stands from 6c dev tier.

duplicate_print_check.method: APPROX (HyperLogLog: approx_count_distinct on hash of the strict key), per bar, summed per event. Cooper 2026-07-28: exact COUNT(DISTINCT) over ~billions of near-unique composite keys is computationally infeasible in one pass (a first attempt spilled 350GB / ran 2.5h and was killed before it filled the disk). HLL uses fixed small per-group state (bounded, fast). The exact 0.0% strict-dup record stands from Phase 6c's dev-tier A8/T3'' check (56 events).
duplicate_print_check.strict_key: (event key, sip_timestamp, price, size, sequence_number) - same key as 6c A8/T3''. sequence_number always exists in filtered_trades; same ts/price/size with different sequence_number are ordinary distinct prints, not duplicate ingestion.
duplicate_print_check.looser_key_reported: (event key, sip_timestamp, price, size) - reported alongside
duplicate_print_check.diagnostic_role: coarse population dup tripwire, NOT an exact gate. Row 7 flags any event whose APPROX strict rate exceeds 5% (well above HLL per-event noise, measured ~2% max on the clean dev tier) - a gross-duplication signal for a targeted exact recheck, not an automatic hard stop at 0.1%.
duplicate_print_check.note: A8.2 requirement - computed within the single budgeted full pass, no extra pass over filtered_trades

chart_08: dropped (A8.2) - the basis-diagnostic chart is moot under D4's severance; the contract runs to 07
